# featureflip_flag_trigger (Resource)

A flag trigger: a secret URL that turns one flag on or off in one environment when a monitoring tool (a Grafana alert, a Datadog monitor) POSTs to it. Calling it when the flag is already in the target state changes nothing. Needs the Team plan or above.

The URL and secret are only available when the trigger is created or rotated, and are stored in Terraform state — protect your state. Change `rotation_keepers` to rotate them in place: the old URL stops working at once. Destroying this resource deletes the trigger and its URL stops working.

Import with `<project>/<flag>/<environment>/<trigger-id>`; imported triggers cannot recover the URL until they are rotated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A kill switch a Grafana alert can pull: POSTing to the URL turns the flag off
# in production. Calling it when the flag is already off changes nothing.
resource "featureflip_flag_trigger" "checkout_errors" {
  project     = featureflip_project.web.key
  flag        = featureflip_feature_flag.new_checkout.key
  environment = "production"
  name        = "Grafana: checkout error rate"
  action      = "Disable"

  # Change this value to rotate the URL in place, e.g. after it leaks.
  # The old URL stops working at once.
  rotation_keepers = {
    rotated = "2026-11-06"
  }
}

# The URL contains the secret and lives in Terraform state. Store it in the
# monitoring tool as a secret.
output "checkout_kill_switch_url" {
  value     = featureflip_flag_trigger.checkout_errors.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Disable turns the flag off (a kill switch); Enable turns it on. Immutable.
- `environment` (String)
- `flag` (String) Key of the flag the trigger turns on or off.
- `name` (String)
- `project` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether calling the URL does anything. false makes it answer 404 until re-enabled. Defaults to true.
- `rotation_keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that, when set or changed, rotate the trigger's URL and secret in place, e.g. `{ rotated = "2026-11-06" }`. The trigger keeps its id and history. Setting them on an imported trigger is how it gets a URL into state. Removing them does not rotate.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) The URL without the secret, for tools that can send a header: POST to it with `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The trigger's secret, for the `Authorization: Bearer` form. Null for imported triggers until rotated.
- `secret_last_four` (String)
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The URL a monitoring tool POSTs to. Contains the secret. Null for imported triggers until rotated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <project>/<flag>/<environment>/<trigger-id>. The URL cannot be
# recovered on import: set rotation_keepers and apply to get a new one.
terraform import featureflip_flag_trigger.checkout_errors web/new-checkout/production/0199a8c4-5b1e-7c2d-9f3a-4e6b8d0c1a2f
```
